title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
tip: Onsite favorite. Preorder gives the root; inorder splits left/right.
statement: Given two integer arrays `preorder` and `inorder` where `preorder` is the preorder traversal of a binary tree and `inorder` is the inorder traversal of the same tree (distinct values), construct and return the binary tree.
constraints: inorder is the inorder of the tree, preorder is the preorder of the tree.
followUp: O(n) with an index map for inorder.
editorial: Root = preorder[0]. Find it in inorder. Left size = index. Recurse on slices. Map value→inorder index.
